baseline_dogmas: Constitutional AI principles can be codified without cultural or ideological skew.
Judicial oversight can keep pace with sub-second algorithmic decisions.
human_blindspots: Unaccountable algorithmic arbiters establishing international trade precedent outside public courts
Slow disenfranchisement of human electorate as policy optimization becomes mathematically uninterpretable

unasked_questions.question: Can democratic institutions maintain legitimacy when policy choices are proven optimal by algorithms no voter understands?
What happens when sovereign constitutional amendments are written and ratified by consensus among autonomous AI systems?
